notes.title: Blade Arcus: Ver1.07 Update + Challenge Justin Wong!
notes.notes:
[h1]Details[/h1]
[list][*]Refined and improved the network synchronization code for matching
[*]Fixed other minor bugs[/list]

[h1]Weekend Sale[/h1]
Our friends over at Degica Games have also included us in their Weekend Sale!
You can get Blade Arcus From Shining: Battle Arena for 35% off. There's also a few more Studio Saizensen titles like Umihara Kawase and Code of Princess. Check out the sale here:
http://store.steampowered.com/sale/degica/

[h1]Challenge Justin Wong on Thursday Night Fights!![/h1]
We're proud to announce that we will have the legendary fighting game player [b]Justin Wong[/b] at today's [url=https://www.twitch.tv/degigames]Thursday Night Fights[/url]!
You can actually challenge him via online mode, or watch his super technique and learn how to become a Blade Arcus champion! We will start streaming from [b]7pm PDT on 20th Oct[/b]. Bring your skills and don't miss this big event!!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25670286/bc99afca974e3ec4423309ad67e426f22700cb39.png[/img]

[h1] Giveaway![/h1]
We’re also running a giveaway this weekend with [b]$1000 in Steam Wallet Codes[/b] up for grabs! You can get all of details and enter here: http://promo.degicagames.com/weekend-deal-giveaway/

notes.title: Blade Arcus: Ver1.03 Update! Online Mode adjustments
notes.notes:
Hi there,
We've made a few small changes to the Online Mode for Blade Arcus.

[h1]Details[/h1]
[list][*]Adjusted the matching system decreasing the odds of being matched with the same opponent repeatedly.
[*]Increased the number of scores displayed on the Leaderboard [/list]

Just a small update this time but we are continuing to monitor feedback from users and fix bugs/improve the game wherever possible.

Please feel free to join us on on the steam community forums! 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/446040/discussions/

Until next time,

The Blade Arcus From Shining: Battle Arena Team

notes.title: Blade Arcus: Ver1.02 Update! Leaderboards fix
notes.notes:
[h1]Detail[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Adjusted EXP system in Ranking Match
    [*]Fixed a bug in Leaderboards[/list] 
A bug has been found in the Leaderboards so we are transferring to a new one.
By starting up the updated app, the old Leaderboards data will start transferring.
The transferring process will take a few minutes to complete. DO NOT turn off your computer or terminate the app while the transferring is in progress.
After this process is done, you will be able to play online mode.

[h1]Notice[/h1]
[list]
[*]Old versions will not be able to match online with new versions, please make sure your app is updated.
    [*]If you are not able to play the online mode after the update, restart the app and try again until the transferring process is done.
[/list]
